description:
Check an EPCIS 2.0 JSON document against the GS1 schema AND the OpenEPCIS rules — the
same two validators the capture endpoint runs. Call this on every document you produce,
before you present it; a document that fails here will be rejected on capture.

Reports the two layers separately, because they are different properties: the schema
permits things that are wrong in this architecture, such as `ilmd` on a serialised item.

Repairs are listed as things for YOU to fix, not applied. A document that needed a repair
is a document whose shape was wrong.
name: validateEpcisDocument
title: Validate an EPCIS document
